title: Orphan drive-in
blurb: Monsters, mad science and Roger Corman from the back row of the fifties and early sixties, made fast and cheap by people who had moved on to the next one.

films.note: Roger Corman's beatnik satire: a busboy becomes the coffee house's star sculptor. Don't ask what's under the clay.
Dennis Hopper's first lead, as a sailor who falls for a woman who plays a mermaid on the pier. Dreamlike and odd.
Boris Karloff and a young Jack Nicholson in a castle Corman shot in a few days on leftover sets.
A surgeon keeps his fiancée's head alive in a pan while he shops for a new body.
A cosmetics queen tries a youth serum made from wasp jelly. Corman, 1959.
Giant shrews, played by dogs in shag carpet, trap a party on an island in a hurricane.
A teenage-idol caveman in Palm Springs. Famous for being one of the worst films ever made.
